authorized_recovery.scope: Authorized disposable-test export after both role processes finish. This recipient reconstructs the canonical seed and complete private material, compares the expanded FIPS encoding with OpenSSL, and signs with the recovered ordinary key.

threshold_signing.scope: Two separate role processes sign before authorized test recovery. Neither role reads peer material or reconstructs a seed or expanded key.
security_limits: Public rejected challenge hashes rely on the proposed random-oracle composition. A complete security proof and independent cryptographic review remain open.
Rejected w1, masks, z, low coefficients, hints, and individual validity checks remain shared. Only aggregate acceptance and retry count become public.
Shared-host files and processes provide no operating-system isolation or production admission claim.
The linear arithmetic has no target-specific constant-time qualification. Classical OT provides no post-quantum transcript confidentiality claim.

limits: Three zero-delay measured samples follow warm-up. Delay cases inject half the declared RTT before each outgoing online message; they do not emulate a real network.
Native timings do not predict Wasm or Cloudflare latency. Tables are read from local disk, not remote object storage.
The consuming handles enforce single use in memory. No durable pool, rollback protection, peer authentication, or admission is implemented.
scope: Input-independent fresh garbling and random OT, followed by wallet-derived canonical keygen. Separate native roles, role-local disk tables, and private input correction. No production storage or hosted latency claim.
